data.name: FocusLinesDescription
data.value: Covers the screen with lines that converge on a point.

data.name: UrchinFlashDescription
data.value: Lines spread outward like spines around a clear center.

data.name: BetaFlashDescription
data.value: Fills the screen with a solid color and rays of light from the center.

data.name: SpeedLinesDescription
data.value: Covers the screen with parallel lines moving in one direction.

data.name: SunburstDescription
data.value: Covers the screen with rays spreading out from the center.

data.name: CenterDescription
data.value: Position relative to the center of the screen. You can also drag the preview handle.

data.name: FocusThicknessDescription
data.value: Line thickness at the edge of the screen.

data.name: ClearSizePercentDescription
data.value: Size of the clear center as a percentage of the screen dimensions.

data.name: ClearSizePixelsDescription
data.value: Size of the clear area at the center.

data.name: JaggednessDescription
data.value: Variation in where lines start, as a percentage of the clear area's size.

data.name: TwistDescription
data.value: Curves the lines into a spiral.

data.name: UpdateIntervalLinesDescription
data.value: Redraws the lines at this interval. Set to 0 to stop redrawing.

data.name: UpdateIntervalSpeedLinesDescription
data.value: Redraws the lines at this interval. Set to 0 to disable redrawing.

data.name: UpdateIntervalFlashDescription
data.value: Redraws the rays at this interval. Set to 0 to stop redrawing.

data.name: AngleDescription
data.value: Direction of the lines. At 0, they move to the right.

data.name: SpeedLengthDescription
data.value: Line length as a percentage of the screen length in the direction of the lines.

data.name: SpeedDescription
data.value: How fast the lines move. Set to 0 to stop them.

data.name: ClearBandDescription
data.value: Width of the clear band through the middle, as a percentage of the screen.

data.name: FlashLengthDescription
data.value: Ray length as a percentage of the distance from the clear area to the screen edge.

data.name: FlashThicknessDescription
data.value: Thickness of the rays at their base.

data.name: FlashFillDescription
data.value: Fills the area outside the rays and the clear center.

data.name: LightDescription
data.value: When unset, the rays become transparent cutouts.

data.name: RayWidthDescription
data.value: Ray width as a percentage of the combined width of a ray and its gap.

data.name: BackgroundDescription
data.value: Fills the gaps between the rays.
